title: Raw Block Smelting
description: Adds smelting for raw blocks ( iron, copper, gold ) in furnace and blast furnace
body:
# **Key Features**
**Direct Smelting**: Toss a Raw Iron Block, Raw Gold Block, or Raw Copper Block directly into any furnace or blast furnace.

**Massive Time Savings**: Process 9 ores in a single smelting slot.

**Balanced Mechanics**: By default, smelting a block takes the same amount of time as a single item but yields the full ore block for high-effiency smelting.

**Plug & Play**: No configuration required. Drop the JAR into your plugins folder and start smelting immediately.
